description: E19.g G2e-0 predictions of the demo EffectQuadDemo (rule B(k), top-left tie rule). Generated by g2e_predict.py.

texture.formula: texel (i, j): R = 12 + 3 (i % 64); G = 12 + 3 (j % 64); B = 12 + (i // 64) * 18 + (j // 64); alpha = 0 if (i + 2 j) % 23 == 5, else 128 if (i + j) % 4 == 1, else 255; texel (511, 0) = background (96, 112, 128, 255); straight (non-premultiplied) alpha, SurfaceFormat.Color, PointClamp

frame.note: image = the top-left 320 k x 240 k pixels of the back-buffer (>= that size); camera Zoom = k, Target = (w / 2k, -h / 2k) of the back-buffer w x h, so a PS1 point (x, y) is the screen point (k x, k y); background = a sprite of texel (511, 0) covering the frame; every quad drawn with Color.White, z = 0

noise_rule: texel within 2^-10 texel of a boundary (exact ties excluded, i.e. kept) or pixel top-left corner within 2^-10 px of an edge or the TR-BL diagonal (exact distance 0 excluded, i.e. kept); exact ties are decided by the top-left rule
tolerance_rule: opaque and background pixels exact; a pixel last written by a blended STP draw (modes Mode0 to Mode2) +-1 per channel
